text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 1477
GRANTING PHILIPPINE CITIZENSHIP TO RONALD IAN LAING WITH ALL THE RIGHTS,
PRIVILEGES AND PREROGATIVES APPURTENANT THERETO
WHEREAS, Ronald Ian Laing, a subject of Great Britain, has manifested his desire to become a Philippine
WHEREAS, Ronald Ian Laing was born on June 19, 1915, in Manila and has continuously resided in the
Philippines since then;
WHEREAS, he was conferred a Presidential Service Award on June 11, 1977, for his special services to the
Government of the Philippines and the Filipino people;
WHEREAS, he has mingled socially with our people, embraced our customs, traditions and ideals and learned
to speak one of our dialects; and
WHEREAS, by virtue of his exceptional service and contributions to the betterment of our people and
country, Ronald Ian Laing has proven himself worthy of all the rights, privileges and prerogatives of a citizen
of this country.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President/Prime Minister of the Republic of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby grant Philippine citizenship to
RONALD IAN LAING with all the rights privileges and prerogatives appurtenant thereto.
These Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
